question:
From 2000 to 2005, what percentage of drivers who were born before 1985 and the lap numbers were over 50?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: born before 1985 refers to year(dob)<1985; in 2000 to 2005 refers to year between 2000 and 2005; percentage = Divide(COUNT(driverId where year (dob) <1985 and laps >50),COUNT(DriverID where year between 2000 and 2005) *100;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(d.XCL_040,1,4) < '1985' AND r.XCL_086 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
JOIN drivers d ON r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
WHERE ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
